author: umarmullaai
caption:
Make AI videos right on your own computer 🎬
FreeVideo runs MiniMax H3 locally and works with ComfyUI. It’s designed to run on consumer hardware with as little as 8 GB VRAM and 16 GB RAM - though generation speed and results depend on your setup.

Available for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Open source and free to try.
